messages.author: AndyTheHusky
messages.text:
I'm econ for my coalition and it's so TIRING having to pull out an actual calculator and do everything one by one to write down economic plans.

I also don't know how land/city scales, and I'm too tired to integrate shit. As if I know how to get integrals.

best i can do is make an excel sheet and apply assumptions.

Anyway...

- **land cost calculator** - input starting land, input target land or land to be bought. helps us take into account cost scaling
- **city cost calculator** -  same as land cost calculator except for city/districts
- **building cost calculator** - for all buildings, not just the ones you can build in your biome.

messages.author: Kurai
messages.text: Finally someone else understands my suffering
